page.content:
Earth's mightiest heroes team.

How Avengers connects

  • Topic: Marvel — The Avengers are central to Marvel.
  • Character: Iron Man — Iron Man is a founding Avenger.
  • Character: Captain America — Captain America leads and serves the Avengers.
  • Character: Thanos — Thanos wars against the Avengers.
  • Character: Thor — Thor fights with the Avengers.
  • Character: Hulk — The Hulk is a founding Avenger.
  • Faction: S.H.I.E.L.D. — S.H.I.E.L.D. midwifes the Avengers.
  • Character: Black Panther — Black Panther allies with the Avengers.
  • Character: Spider-Man — Spider-Man has served with the Avengers.

What is Avengers?

The Avengers unite Iron Man, Captain America, Thor, the Hulk, and later heroes against threats like Loki and Thanos, central to both comics and the MCU.

Key threads lead to Marvel, Iron Man, Captain America, Thanos, Thor and Hulk.
